source_binding.value: For fraflyttet bolig dekkes kun brann- og naturskade dersom annet ikke er avtalt. En bolig regnes som fraflyttet når den ikke har vært bebodd de siste 12 måneder.

semantic_contract.subject: Bygningsforsikring for boligen
semantic_contract.trigger: Boligen har ikke vært bebodd de siste 12 måneder, og regnes da som fraflyttet
semantic_contract.period: 12 måneder, source wording retained; no day conversion or invented greater-than threshold
semantic_contract.consequence: Bare brann- og naturskade dekkes i denne situasjonen
semantic_contract.limit_basis: Scope of covered causes, no sum, deductible or compensation period
semantic_contract.level: Both Standard and Pluss; no requirement of full-value insurance added
semantic_contract.optionality: Base conditional policy rule, independent of rental/Smart/rot choices
semantic_contract.customer_applicability: Generic catalog rule, not evidence that this customer has vacated the home. No automatic downgrade of water/theft/other coverage, customer state, add-ons or premiums. Customer document terms and explicit different agreement take priority.

rejected_reuse.reason: General policy precedence does not identify the vacancy subject/12-month trigger/fire-natural-damage limit. Reusing the row hides an independent material dimension and its page-2 source.

Fremtind uses an IPID overview bundle. That provider/source/package and its multiple dimensions are not an approved exact Gjensidige vacancy identity; 12-month definition and unless-otherwise-agreed reservation must remain explicit.
Full value/first loss and settlement form do not have the vacancy trigger; this restriction is stated for building insurance without a full-value-only qualifier.
Post-loss inability to use a dwelling differs from not having inhabited it during the previous 12 months; reusing would conflate trigger, purpose and compensation.
Rental optionality and contractual move-out obligations do not express a base-building vacancy restriction. Rule applies independently of rental choice.

Tryg bundles rebuilding/rental notification with a causation-dependent vacancy exclusion; no Gjensidige 12-month definition and no identical only-fire/natural-damage limit. Reuse would create false cross-provider equivalence.
Tryg frost precautions after a month unoccupied, and B130 ce90710821e28a97 frost/protection review, have different time, action and legal effect; retain separately.
Not an existing reusable identity. Synthetic representation probe shows .dekning infers a new selected coverage. Selected detail ends .begrensning and infers no new coverage.
